tutorial.untouched_status: confirmed -- video_id not present in any prior W1/C3/Gate-B evidence run

real_bugs_found_and_fixed_in_pipeline_in.bug: ACQUIRE stage called .get() on VisualFrameArtifact dataclass instances (not dicts), crashing every run.
real_bugs_found_and_fixed_in_pipeline_in.fix: serum2/pipeline/runner.py: use attribute access (f.frame_id, f.artifact_hash, etc.) matching the real dataclass fields.
real_bugs_found_and_fixed_in_pipeline_in.scope: Pipeline glue/orchestration code only -- no policy, contract, or admission logic touched.

real_bugs_found_and_fixed_in_pipeline_in.bug: ACQUIRE stage omitted max_frames when None (meaning 'no cap' per the CLI's own docs), silently falling back to acquire_visual_evidence's own unrelated default of 8 frames -- a silent truncation trap for a 539s video.
real_bugs_found_and_fixed_in_pipeline_in.fix: Pass an explicit large value (10000) when max_frames is None instead of omitting the kwarg.

real_bugs_found_and_fixed_in_pipeline_in.bug: TRANSCRIPT stage looked for fetch_transcript's output at serum2/data/sources/*video_id*/*.json (stale assumption); the actual current implementation writes to <cwd>/data/transcripts/<source_id>.json.
real_bugs_found_and_fixed_in_pipeline_in.fix: Corrected the expected output path using the real compute_source_id() + the real write location.

real_bugs_found_and_fixed_in_pipeline_in.bug: OBSERVATION stage called engine.observe_control_in_frame(frame_path, control_id) -- a method that did not exist anywhere in observation_engine.py. Every call raised AttributeError, silently caught by a broad except-continue, producing a fabricated-looking '0 admissible observations' result that was actually '0 real inference attempts ever succeeded', not a genuine adjudication outcome.
real_bugs_found_and_fixed_in_pipeline_in.fix: Implemented observe_control_in_frame() for real: a generic locate -> crop -> transcribe -> explicit-null mechanism (adapted from this repo's own earlier roi_crop_extractor.py prototype) using real local Qwen2.5-VL-3B-Instruct + real local easyocr 1.7.2, with a small fast-path crop registry (2 controls, Serum-UI-layout-based fractions, not video-specific) as an optimization only. Never guesses; explicitly returns UNREADABLE when the VLM cannot locate or read a value.
real_bugs_found_and_fixed_in_pipeline_in.scope: New method + 5 new lazy-loaded helper functions in serum2/producer/observation_engine.py. No change to observation_policy.py (adjudicate/CONFIDENT_THRESHOLD/GAP A-B-C logic untouched), no change to any Gate A/B/admission/contract file.

known_remaining_limitation.issue: serum2/producer/w2_fast_path.py's temporal_candidates() selects candidate frames from a hardcoded _TUTORIAL_CANDIDATE_WINDOWS list keyed to THIS specific video's timeline/chapters (with comments literally referencing prior manual findings for this exact video) -- this is a per-video shortcut, not the generic, parameter-agnostic candidate-selection mechanism the task requires. It was not rewritten this session (a truly generic mechanism would need to scan across many/all of the 269 frames for each of the 330 contract-covered controls, which is not tractable in this session's time budget with per-frame VLM inference). This is a genuine, documented architecture gap, not something papered over.
known_remaining_limitation.impact: The 15 real observations collected this run came from the 6 controls covered by the hardcoded window list, not from a full generic sweep. observe_control_in_frame() itself IS generic (works for any control_id via locate+transcribe); temporal_candidates() (which decides WHICH frames to try it on) is not.

real_observation_result.notable_finding: oscA.octave at t=22s: VLM hallucinated '4088' as a single source (genuinely wrong) -- correctly remained AMBIGUOUS under GAP B (single-source, never admitted) rather than becoming a confident-wrong observation. This is the safety invariant working exactly as designed even when the underlying VLM read is bad.

blocker.exact_condition: 0 of 15 real Stage-A observations reached OUTCOME_OBSERVED with an execution-contract row. Most resolved UNREADABLE (VLM genuinely could not locate/read the control in that frame) or AMBIGUOUS (single-source, or the one case with a 2nd source it disagreed). Per Phase 5, only OBSERVED values may enter the state ledger -- with 0 OBSERVED, LEDGER/ADMISSION/COMPILE/NATIVE_LOAD/NATIVE_VERIFY/REFERENCE_VERIFY/ARRANGE/RENDER were never reached by the pipeline (correctly -- it fails closed rather than fabricating an input to feed them).
blocker.conclusion: Genuine, reproducible stop condition from the real pipeline command after fixing 4 real infrastructure bugs (3 pipeline glue bugs + 1 missing method). Not fixed by weakening the architecture or fabricating evidence. FINAL_STATUS = PRODUCT_NOT_CLOSED.
